hypotheses.construction_plan: Define F(x)=V(x)*G0(x)*V(x). The first member is F(p), the second member is F(q); the full expression is F(p)+F(q).
hypotheses.rationale: The two summands have exactly the same multiplicative skeleton V(·)*G0(·)*V(·) with only the symbol in the argument varying. This directly indicates a one-parameter family indexed by x, specialized at p and q.
